title: “Border Police” wants a mobile fine
scenario: You receive a call after crossing a border. The caller knows your nationality and says a camera recorded a customs violation. They text a payment link and warn that an unpaid fine could affect your return journey.

answers.A: Pay the fine by card if the text page uses the government crest and gives you a downloadable receipt.
answers.B: End the call and contact the border/customs authority through its official published channels to verify whether any case exists.
answers.C: Ask the caller for a case number and officer name, write them down, and verify them independently before taking action.

explanation: Government branding and personal details are easy to imitate. The existence of a case must be verified independently.
proTip: Authority should make verification stricter, not obedience faster.
